desc:
Welcome to Daybreak! Daybreak is a 1v8 asymmetrical horror game where you either play as the ruthless hunter or a team-oriented survivor each with their own unique abilities.

SURVIVORS: Help your teammates, complete generators, and loop the killer to escape! Support, stealth, repair, or chase - the choice is yours!
KILLER: Use your abilities to wipe out all the survivors before they escape! Be a ruthless hunter or a calculated objective defender! 

FEATURES
> Play as a diverse and unique cast of characters with their own abilities!
> Unlock all sorts of skins, voice lines, and other cosmetics!
> Voice acting!
> Progress through the archives and learn about the characters and their stories!
> Level up your characters!

👍Be sure to like the game if you enjoyed it!
